definitions.overdue: Yours, and its due time has passed with nothing recording it done.
definitions.missing_date: A live deal whose stage needs a date that is not on record.
definitions.blocking_closing: A closing deadline passed unmet, or the Closing Desk marks the closing blocked.
definitions.stale_follow_up: A follow-up or reply whose time passed with no message out and no newer seller message — or a send that did not go out.
definitions.missed_campaign_schedule: A campaign start that passed without activating, or campaign sends past their time that have not gone out.
definitions.waiting_too_long: A workflow timer that ran out more than 15 minutes ago without the run resuming, or a held run.

basis.today: Open (not completed, cancelled or superseded) events on your calendar day; a window that spans today counts once.
basis.system: Of today's open events, those the system owns (campaigns, automation, workflows).
basis.needs_you: Attention items you own plus today's open items you own.
basis.attention: Distinct attention events over the range and the 14-day lookback (the attention board).
basis.next: The next open timed event after now.
